title: TPS Overlay
description: This project adds a lightweight, configurable HUD overlay for monitoring server TPS, MSPT and ping. Also optional metrics graph as a primary overlay widget
body:
TPS Overlay shows server and client performance on screen without opening the F3 debug overlay. You get TPS, MSPT, ping, and FPS in a small HUD that you can move around and tune to your liking.

The text line uses a custom format with placeholders - show only what you care about. There's also an optional graph that scrolls over time; turn individual metrics on or off if the panel feels crowded.

On servers with the mod installed, TPS and MSPT are measured properly and sent to clients. On a vanilla server you'll still see ping and FPS; server metrics simply won't appear. Use `/tpso help` for client commands and `/tpsc` when you want numbers in chat.

Config is in YACL (Mod Menu button if you have it). Position both widgets with `/tpso edit`.
